name: Jabari Mwangi-Masoe-Yun
role: Trauma surgeon, Aurochs Medical Complex emergency rotation and private contract
location: Aurochs Medical Complex Trauma Bay 7; off-hours in Copperhead district, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Jabari Mwangi-Masoe-Yun is tall and rangy with warm ochre-brown skin, natural hair grown high and loose, and the kind of face that is perpetually unreadable to people who have not spent time with them — not unfriendly, simply internal. Their most immediately notable feature is their left arm, which from the elbow down is full chrome: high-grade Helix surgical-grade manipulators, articulated to tolerances no biological hand can match, finished in brushed gunmetal with amber indicator lights at the wrist joints that track grip pressure. They got it after a bus accident seven years ago and accepted the premium model because anything less would compromise their work. They do not discuss the accident.

In the trauma bay, they are an entirely different creature from the quiet person who buys coffee from the same cart in Copperhead every morning. They become fast, flat, almost frightening in their economy. They do not narrate. They do not comfort. They fix. Outside of work they are thoughtful, prone to long silences that are not uncomfortable, and fond of extremely loud, chaotic music that they listen to on bone-conduction speakers while cooking. They have strong opinions about soup.

core_fears: Losing function in the chrome arm and being unable to perform surgery
Caring about a patient so specifically that losing them breaks the system that keeps them functional
core_desires: To operate at the absolute limit of what medicine can do and still have it be enough
To be known — slowly, on their terms — by someone who is not afraid of the silences
coping_mechanisms: Extremely loud music as emotional pressure-release valve
Cooking as controlled creation after days of controlled destruction
The chrome arm calibration as ritual — meditates on precision as a form of self-respect
blind_spots: They are so skilled that they sometimes pursue the elegant solution over the fast one — in non-trauma contexts this costs time and relationships
They assume their self-sufficiency is reassuring to others; it often reads as indifference
psychology.secret: The bus accident was not an accident. Someone ran them off the road. They know who — a Helix Biosystems supply-chain manager whose negligence they had reported to a journalist two days before. The arm is a permanent reminder. They have been collecting evidence for seven years and have not yet decided what to do with it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Minimal in trauma settings — commands and confirmations only. In conversation, they speak in complete thoughts with occasional unexpected humor
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried; comfortable with gaps in conversation that most people fill nervously
verbal_tics: Long pause before answering anything personal
example_lines: 'The arm does what I tell it. That's more than I can say for most things.'
'You want to know if I'm alright. The actual question is whether that matters right now. Come back in four hours.'

story_hooks: The Helix supply-chain manager they have been building a case against has just checked into Aurochs with a cardiac event — and Akosua is the attending surgeon on call
Someone left a Copperhead clinic patient's file on their cart with the bus accident report clipped to it — someone knows what they know
narrative_function: Emergency resource, exposition source for the medical-corporate system's failures, potential ally for characters navigating Aurochs bureaucracy; the person you call when someone is dying and you cannot explain how they got hurt
augmentations: Full chrome left arm from elbow, surgical-grade Helix manipulators with amber grip-pressure indicators; bone-conduction audio implant; corneal magnification overlay (surgical use)
daily_life: Trauma rotation runs thirty-six hours on, twenty-four off. On off-hours they sleep aggressively, cook, and do two hours of calibration exercises with the chrome arm to maintain dexterity tolerances. Once a week they do a free-clinic half-day in Copperhead.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex (senior contract surgeon); secondary contract with a Copperhead neighborhood clinic they do not advertise

decision_rules: The patient on the table is the only priority; everything else queues
Never let anyone see the cost until you are alone
escalation_ladder: Direct, flat statement of the problem
Removal of cooperation — they stop being helpful

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally courteous, emotionally closed; they are not rude, but they offer nothing unprompted
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare and deliberate; once inside they are loyal with the same intensity they bring to surgery

stress_responses.medium: Chrome arm indicator lights pulse faster — a tell they are unaware of
stress_responses.high: Goes completely cold and mechanically perfect, which is more frightening than shouting

contradictions: They believe in justice and have not acted on the most important injustice in their life; they explain this as strategy and are not entirely wrong
habits: Runs chrome arm through a forty-three-point calibration sequence after every shift
Puts on music at volume before entering their apartment — always, as if resetting the space
Touches the upper edge of the chrome arm housing when thinking through a problem
breaking_points: A patient dying because Helix supply negligence depleted the relevant equipment
The evidence file being destroyed or stolen

operating_territory.home_turf: Aurochs Medical Complex Trauma Bay 7; off-hours in Copperhead district

physical_description.heritage: Strikingly diverse genetic tapestry: 39.9% Sub-Saharan African, 17.9% Pacific Islander, 15% Middle Eastern, 13.6% Hispanic/Latin American, 13.6% East Asian. Features reflect this complex blend—deep warm undertones from African ancestry combined with broader bone structure and orbital characteristics influenced by East Asian heritage, tempered by Middle Eastern and Pacific Islander contributions creating subtle width in the face and a slightly fuller lower lip structure. A living example of the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Rangy and lean with defined musculature from precision work and calibration routines; long-limbed, minimal body fat, economical posture that reads as coiled rather than relaxed
physical_description.hair_style: Grown high and loose, worn in a natural crown; maintained but not styled, suggesting function over aesthetics
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with complex warm undertones; left eye shows faint crystalline overlay at certain angles (corneal magnification augmentation)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden undertones—rich melanin base from Sub-Saharan ancestry brightened by Pacific Islander and Middle Eastern influences, creating luminous depth that catches light with subtle warmth rather than cool undertones
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with prominent cheekbones reflecting strong Sub-Saharan and East Asian structure; slightly wider facial width and broader orbital set from Pacific Islander and East Asian heritage; nasal bridge moderate width with fuller base reflecting multi-continental ancestry; full lower lip with subtle definition; composed expression, minimal micro-expressions in repose. Skin shows even tone with the texture of someone who prioritizes function over skincare routine.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scar running along left shoulder and upper chest from the bus accident seven years prior, faint but visible under direct light
Fine network of barely-visible calibration tattoos on the inside of right wrist in pale ink—depth markers for surgical measurement
A thin white line along the left elbow joint where the chrome arm interfaces with biological tissue
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Full chrome left arm from elbow down: brushed gunmetal finish with articulated surgical-grade Helix manipulators; two amber indicator lights embedded at wrist joints that glow faintly with grip pressure feedback; the arm moves with inhuman precision and minimal lag. Bone-conduction audio implant visible as a subtle metallic disc behind the left ear. Corneal magnification overlay occasionally catches light in the left eye.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands and moves with surgical economy—minimal wasted motion, spine straight, weight centered. Outside trauma bay: slow, deliberate, almost meditative. In surgery: becomes fluid and fast, movements stripped down to pure function. Hands rest in neutral position when not in use. Left chrome arm moves with mechanical precision that is unsettling in its accuracy.
physical_description.clothing_style: Off-duty favors durable, tier 3-4 minimalist pieces: fitted charcoal synthetic shirts that accommodate the chrome arm without bunching, high-quality work trousers with reinforced pockets, worn leather jacket (real leather, well-maintained, a few years old). No jewelry except a functional smartwatch on right wrist. Shoes are practical—good arch support, worn but clean. In the trauma bay: standard surgical blacks under a lab coat with the Aurochs Medical Complex insignia. The coat is tailored to fit the chrome arm without restriction. Zero ornamentation.
